summary.text: Lindsey Prather is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 115 in Buncombe County who has served since January 1, 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia describes her as a former special education and social studies teacher in Buncombe County Schools.

paragraphs.text: Prather graduated from Cary High School, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a B.A. in sociology from the University of North Carolina, Asheville, in 2010 and an M.P.A. from Western Carolina University in 2019.
Her career has included work as a special education teacher and a social studies teacher in Buncombe County Schools, and the General Assembly lists her occupation as university admissions.

Prather serves on the House Appropriations, Higher Education, Pensions and Retirement, and State and Local Government committees, the Appropriations Subcommittee on Education, and the House Select Committee on Helene Recovery.
